title: AppleSauce
tagline: AppleSauce: a AI Discord bot powered by ElizaOS with 0xMert as the character, Anthropic API, and Gaia AI. It cracks crypto jokes, roasts HODLers
description: AppleSauce is an AI-powered Discord bot with 0xMert as the character designed to bring jokes and entertainment to crypto communities. Built on the ElizaOS framework, it integrates with the Discord API to deliver crypto-themed jokes, memes, and roasts in real-time. The bot uses Anthropic API for natural language understanding and Gaia AI models for generating context-aware, humorous responses. Whether you're a Bitcoin maximalist, an NFT collector, or just here for the memes, AppleSauce keeps the vibes light and the laughs rolling—even when the market is crashing.
how_its_made:
Core Framework:

Built on ElizaOS, a decentralised AI agent framework, for modularity and scalability.

ElizaOS handles agent orchestration, memory management, and integration with external APIs.

AI Models:

Anthropic API: Used for natural language understanding and generating coherent, context-aware responses.

Gaia AI Models: Fine-tuned for humour and crypto-specific knowledge, ensuring the bot’s jokes are relevant and timely.

Discord Integration:

Connected via the Discord API to listen to messages, detect crypto-related keywords, and respond with jokes or memes.


Tech Stack:

Backend: Typescript + ElizaOS (for AI agent management).

APIs: Anthropic API  Discord API , and Gaia AI 

Database: sqlite database for storing crypto jokes, memes, and user interaction history.

Technologies:

ElizaOS
Anthropic API
Gaia AI
